purpose: Record auditable sources for Phase 1 ML corpus. Phase 1 corpus is provisionally approved for guarded training after family split validation.

productCorpus.reason: Acceptance fixtures are synthetic or controlled regression data and are used to demonstrate deterministic product behavior.

historicalUec.use: research-only; not approved for production or current locked evaluation

limitations: Purpose-written corpus — not independently sourced from production deployments.
Single reviewer — independent adjudication not yet available.
AST-only feature extraction — C++ IR/CFG coupling required before production approval.
Small sample size (16 contracts, 64 annotation rows) — insufficient for robust generalization claims.
